name: tools_list
output:
test_connection        Test connection and authentication to the Google Search Console API
list_sites             List all verified sites in the authenticated Search Console account
get_site_info          Get details and permission level for a specific verified site
search_analytics       Query Search Analytics data (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) by dimension
get_top_queries        Get the top search queries for a site over a lookback window
get_top_pages          Get the top performing pages for a site over a lookback window
list_sitemaps          List all sitemaps submitted for a site
submit_sitemap         Submit (or resubmit) a sitemap to Search Console — a real write operation
get_indexing_status    Inspect a URL with the URL Inspection API (index status, coverage, canonical, richness)
request_indexing       Notify Google of a new or updated URL via the Web Search Indexing API — a real write operation
